archetype: Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast (Adapted for Clinical Trust)
rationale: The healthcare and job portal domain requires utmost trust, clarity, and authority. The brand's Deep Navy (#1A3A5C) and Red (#E84545) naturally fit a high-contrast, professional environment. The Red accent is strictly reserved for critical actions (AED AI Bubble, urgency), while the Deep Navy and logo Teal drive the calm, structured navigation of the app.

headings.strategy: Clean, authoritative, and modern. Tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for large headers to ensure clinical precision without feeling dated.

body.strategy: Highly legible, objective, and functional. Excellent for dense medical data, job listings, and reading CME materials.

primary.usage: Headers, primary navigation tabs, standard primary buttons, key job listing titles.

accent.usage: AED AI floating bubble, urgent notifications, critical actions, high-priority active states.

secondary.usage: Secondary buttons, 'Specialist Access' badges, verified ticks, and positive clinical indicators (derived from logo teal).

grid.strategy: Dense, functional, and organized. 'Control Room' grid layout for dashboards to maximize data visibility for jobs and feeds.

shadows.strategy: Clinical cleanliness. Avoid heavy dark shadows. Use crisp, light drop shadows for elevated elements.

AED_AI_Bubble.style: fixed bottom-20 right-4 sm:right-8 z-50 rounded-full bg-[#E84545] text-white p-4 shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(232,69,69,0.4)] flex items-center justify-center transition-transform hover:scale-105 active:scale-95
AED_AI_Bubble.icon: lucide-react/Bot or custom medical AI icon

Bottom_Navigation.style: fixed bottom-0 w-full bg-white border-t border-slate-200 pb-safe pt-2 px-4 flex justify-around items-center z-40

Job_Card.style: bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 p-5 flex flex-col gap-3 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200

Feed_Post.style: bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 p-4 mb-4
Feed_Post.interaction_bar: flex items-center gap-6 mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 text-slate-500

Buttons.primary: bg-[#1A3A5C] hover:bg-[#2A527D] text-white rounded-lg px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-colors focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#1A3A5C]/50
Buttons.accent: bg-[#E84545] hover:bg-[#D13D3D] text-white rounded-lg px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-colors focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E84545]/50
Buttons.outline: border border-[#1A3A5C] text-[#1A3A5C] hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-lg px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-colors

interactions_and_motion.strategy: Responsive, quick, and snappy. Medical professionals value speed over flashy animations. Use micro-interactions to confirm actions.
interactions_and_motion.hover: Subtle -translate-y-[2px] on cards. Background color shifts on buttons.
interactions_and_motion.loading: Use skeleton loaders rather than full-screen spinners for dashboards.

accessibility.contrast: Strict adherence to WCAG AA. Ensure #E84545 (Red) and #1A3A5C (Navy) have sufficient contrast against white backgrounds. Text over primary buttons must be pure white.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 48x48px for all mobile interactive elements, particularly the bottom tab navigation and AED AI Bubble.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings (focus:ring-2) for keyboard navigability in web views.

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case, role-based format (e.g., data-testid='job-apply-button').

brand_logo.description: ForMeds official logo with teal/navy colors and human figure forming 'M'.

doctor_portraits.description: Male doctor in white coat with eyeglasses

hospital_buildings.description: University Hospitals building against clear sky

learning_hub.description: Medical students in a hospital hallway sharing notes

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. This is a mobile-first hybrid application. Ensure all components map effectively to mobile views, prioritizing touch targets and bottom tab navigation.
2. Stick strictly to the defined color palette: Deep Navy (#1A3A5C) for primary, Red (#E84545) for critical accents/AED Bubble, and Teal (#0F766E) for secondary highlights.
3. Use Outfit for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body text to maintain a clinical yet modern aesthetic.
4. The AED AI Bubble must be persistently accessible across all authenticated screens.
5. Do NOT use generic placeholder images. Use the explicitly provided URLs in the 'media' section for logos, avatars, and cover images.
6. Ensure rigorous adherence to data-testid attributes for testing.
